note: A non-numeric operand (a Label's string added to the count) is a TypeMismatch refusal and leaves the count untouched (C4.4).
ruby_only_reason: no Rust binary to hold it to: the corpus-owned domain spec/corpus/semantics/domains/tally_gaps has no `tally_gaps` feature in rust/Cargo.toml, on purpose: it holds the commands Rust cannot generate yet. AddLabel adds a String-carrying value object to an Integer count, which hecks-codegen declines to generate (manifest: 'sets :count increment/decrement/multiply amount or target field isn't bridgeable').
